name: Sea Serpent of the End
description: (Tag:infernal)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)You can transform into Leviathan, the Sea Serpent of the End. As this giant mythical sea snake, you control all water in range on a massive scale, tilting seas and drowning cities, creating more water serpents, and summoning flood-causing rains. All water-based abilities and effects are massively amplified in this form.
